subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in TUI completion notification contract, and if so should the first supported mode be terminal bell, desktop notification, or reuse of the node notification path?
rationale: The request is useful but adds user-facing config/default behavior and platform notification policy, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve minimal default-off bell
options.body: Add a small opt-in terminal-bell completion notifier first, keeping desktop notifications and sound names out of the initial config surface.

options.title: Design full desktop notifications
options.body: Specify macOS desktop alerts, sound names, platform fallbacks, and privacy/security handling before any implementation starts.

options.title: Defer to external alerting
options.body: Keep core TUI visual-only and direct users to tasks, nodes, or future plugin/watchdog alert surfaces instead.

recommendation.title: Approve minimal default-off bell
recommendation.body: Add a small opt-in terminal-bell completion notifier first, keeping desktop notifications and sound names out of the initial config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history signal across recent TUI lifecycle, docs, and product-surface work relevant to choosing the notification contract.
